content: शस् I. €1 <ab>P.</ab> (शसति) To cut up, kill, destroy. --II. €2 <ab>P.</ab> (शस्ति) To sleep. <ab>Cf.</ab> शंस् also.
शस् .²1 A technical name for the termination of the <ab>acc.</ab> plural. .²2 A Taddhita affix forming adverbs from nouns, especially from numerals; as द्विशः, शतशः, बहुशः <ab>&c.</ab>
